# NFL TNF 2026-11-19: Colts at Texans

No bet.

- Market: Texans -10.5 (Kalshi) to -12.5 (DraftKings); opened -9.5/-10. Total 44.5.
- Covers AI: Texans 27-20, picks Colts +13.5 and Over 44.5 (proj total 47).
- Dimers (updated): Texans 28-16, 85% win, roughly 52.5/47.5 Texans at -10.5.
- Models split on the side (one has a 7-pt margin, the other 12-13) and on the total. Two-model rule fails.
- Line move toward Houston is backed by real injury news: Colts starting OTs Raimann (concussion) and Travis (knee) out, CBs Gardner and Ward missed practice. Houston without Al-Shaair (IR); Hunter, Harrison Jr., Marks missed Tuesday.
- Lean: Colts +12.5 (Houston 1-5 in one-score games, 0 home wins, 8-14 ATS as home fav under Ryans). Bet-worthy only if a second model joins.
- Pass: total (models split).
